source_edition: public Git company-record delivery; separate history-01 and history-02

reporting_frame.trust_services_criteria: 2017 criteria with revised 2022 points of focus
reporting_frame.description_criteria: 2018 description criteria with 2022 guidance; system description not tested by this pilot

selection_rule: All records in the 31 requested security, vulnerability, continuity and transition systems where registered: 27 systems/39 versions in history-01 and 30 systems/55 versions in history-02. Absent requested systems remain explicit scope gaps. No cross-history pooling. The task-specific selected population is a census of the disclosed local-model subpopulation. It is not a full-year enterprise population.

SEC003.population: four selected inventory assets, October census/baseline/schedule/scan, disclosed advisory and later correction/retest versions
SEC003.sample: all four selected assets plus a judgmental disclosed advisory trace
SEC003.procedure: Reconcile exact inventory, baseline, census, schedule and scan IDs and count claims; determine whether the disclosed advisory was available at the initial scan; trace detection, triage, approval, remediation and retest in event/availability order.
SEC003.exception_rule: Record missing scan coverage separately from a missed advisory on an observed asset; do not infer parser or scanner cause from a discrepancy.

SEC005.criterion: SOC2:CC6.6 and CC6.8 (candidate mappings); SEC005 TOE task
SEC005.population: six selected native publisher/probe versions and corresponding collector/review snapshots
SEC005.procedure: Check initial approvals before baseline application. Independently reconstruct publisher IDs available at each collector and company-review cutoff, compare received/reviewed IDs, and retain source model qualifiers.
SEC005.exception_rule: Do not credit a collector-based company review as independent publisher reconciliation or treat a later correction as an initial approval.

BCM003.frequency: quarterly/annual risk-based (authored control; actual cadence unverified)
BCM003.population: all selected MARKER-RECOVERY exercise-result versions, joined to local BIA, technical objectives and authority
BCM003.procedure: Recalculate each recorded start-to-finish duration, compare to the declared local RTO, retain RPO and data-usability assertions as company claims, and trace deviations and later versions.
BCM003.exception_rule: A later exercise version does not erase an earlier failure; recorded marker digest or usability is not an auditor-performed restore.
untested: independent recovered-data age, integrity and usability

review_rule: A separate reviewer or the private scripted grader checks exact source SHA, history separation, population, sample, citations, exception disposition, retest limits and unperformed clauses. A scripted grade is engineering feedback, not professional sign-off.
overall_limit: These three selected procedures do not complete the SOC 2 system description, full-period operating effectiveness, all mapped criteria, HIPAA or assurance opinion.
